verses.1:
A Psalm of David.
 The LORD said to my Lord:
 “Sit at My right hand
 until I make Your enemies
 a footstool for Your feet.” + 110:1 Cited in Matthew 22:44|MAT 22:44 , Mark 12:36, Luke 20:42–43, Acts 2:34–35, and Hebrews 1:13
verses.2:
The LORD extends Your mighty scepter from Zion:
 “Rule in the midst of Your enemies.”
verses.3:
Your people shall be willing
 on Your day of battle.
 Arrayed in holy splendor, from the womb of the dawn,
 to You belongs the dew of Your youth.
verses.4:
The LORD has sworn
 and will not change His mind:
 “You are a priest forever
 in the order of Melchizedek.” + 110:4 Cited in Hebrews 5:6|HEB 5:6 , Hebrews 7:17, and Hebrews 7:21
verses.5:
The Lord is at Your right hand;
 He will crush kings in the day of His wrath.
verses.6:
He will judge the nations, heaping up the dead;
 He will crush the leaders far and wide.
verses.7:
He will drink from the brook by the road;
 therefore He will lift up His head.
